summary: Tuesday: VIX 19.5 (+3.3%), SPY -0.65% breaks 12-day rally. Regime shifts to EARLY RISK-OFF. TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT report tonight. Iran ceasefire expires Wednesday. Oil +5.7%. Defensive rotation underway.

risks.label: Mega-Cap Earnings Binary Risk (Tonight)
risks.detail: TSLA, GOOGL, MSFT report after Tuesday close. Combined $6T+ market cap. Any major miss triggers broad selloff. TSLA deliveries already missed consensus. Markets on edge — VIX rising to 19.5.

risks.label: Iran Ceasefire Expiry (Wednesday)
risks.detail: US-Iran ceasefire expires Wednesday evening. If negotiations fail, oil spikes above $95 and VIX targets 22+. USO already rallied +5.7% Monday pricing in this risk. Energy positions hedge this scenario.

risks.label: Regime Shift: RISK-ON → EARLY RISK-OFF
risks.detail: AutoScreener detected regime shift to early_risk_off (0.575). VIX component flipped bearish, SPX momentum fading. 12-day rally broken. Position sizing should drop to 5-7% per trade. Watch VIX 22 as full RISK-OFF trigger.

risks.label: FOMC Apr 28-29 — Rate Decision
risks.detail: Fed expected to hold at 3.50-3.75%. Statement language on inflation and rate cut timing will move markets. Hawkish surprise (no June cut signal) = growth multiple compression. Oil rebound complicates the disinflation narrative.

risks.label: META Q1 Earnings (Wednesday AMC)
risks.detail: Meta reports Wednesday, completing the mega-cap earnings cluster. AI capex guidance and ad revenue growth are key. Any weakness compounds tonight's TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT reactions.

events.label: TSLA Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 AMC)
events.detail: Consensus EPS $0.37, Revenue $22.3B. Deliveries missed at 358K vs 365K. FSD v13 and Energy Storage are key catalysts. Reports tonight after close.

events.label: GOOGL Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 AMC)
events.detail: Google Cloud growing 28%+ YoY, Gemini AI monetization inflection. At 25x fwd PE, trades at discount to MSFT (30x). Reports tonight.

events.label: MSFT Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 PM)
events.detail: Azure re-acceleration expected ~35% QoQ. Copilot AI ARPU uplift. Already in open positions (+0.46%). Reports this evening.

events.label: US PMI Flash (Apr 23)
events.detail: Manufacturing + Services PMI flash reading. Growth pulse check for Q2. Below 50 = contraction signal. Especially important given oil rebound.

events.label: SAP Q1 Report (Apr 22 pre-market)
events.detail: SAP reports before European open. Cloud backlog growth is key metric. Already in open positions. Direct read on EU enterprise software health.

events.label: Michigan Consumer Sentiment (Apr 25)
events.detail: Final April reading. Oil rebound may pressure consumer confidence. Important gauge ahead of FOMC.

opportunities.label: AAPL Defensive Quality — Score 89
opportunities.detail: Apple above 50/200 DMA, RSI 56.7, reports Apr 30 (safe window). Defensive mega-cap with iPhone AI cycle. 28 analysts rate Buy, avg PT $301 (+13% upside).

opportunities.label: PANW Cybersecurity Breakout — Score 88
opportunities.detail: Palo Alto Networks +3.2% Monday, best performer. Approaching 200-DMA breakout. Cybersecurity demand is regime-agnostic. Iran tensions boost security spend.

opportunities.label: ORCL Cloud Infrastructure — Score 88
opportunities.detail: Oracle +2.0% Monday. OCI cloud growing 50%+ YoY, #3 cloud platform. Multi-cloud partnerships with Azure/GCP. No earnings until June.

opportunities.label: XLE Oversold Energy — Score 86
opportunities.detail: Energy ETF RSI 38.9 (oversold). Iran ceasefire expiry Wednesday = binary catalyst. Cheapest S&P 500 sector at 21.5x PE. Fundamental + technical convergence.

opportunities.label: WMT Defensive Consumer — Score 88
opportunities.detail: Walmart +1.3% while SPY -0.65% Monday. Classic defensive rotation. Above all EMAs, membership flywheel, trade-down beneficiary if oil pressures consumers.

regime_blips.label: VIX Rising to 19.5 — Caution Signal
regime_blips.detail: VIX up 3.3% to 19.5, approaching the 20 threshold. Sub-20 is still technically neutral, but the direction matters. Three consecutive closes above 20 would confirm regime downgrade.

regime_blips.label: 12-Day Rally Broken — Mean Reversion
regime_blips.detail: S&P 500 fell 0.65% Monday, ending the longest winning streak since 2021. Historically, 70% of such streak breaks see 1-3% further pullback before stabilizing.

regime_blips.label: DXY 98.2 — Weak Dollar Tailwind Persists
regime_blips.detail: Dollar weakness continues to support multinational earnings and EM markets. Direct FX tailwind for AAPL, COST, ORCL international revenues.

regime_blips.label: Oil Rebound +5.7% — Inflation Watch
regime_blips.detail: USO surged 5.7% on Iran ceasefire expiry fears. If sustained above $90 WTI, the disinflation narrative weakens and June rate cut probability drops. Watch PPI/CPI revisions.
